svg.title: Rose Éternelle — Scroll Film · Webgl
svg.desc: A scroll-driven fragrance film that moves from video into a layered WebGL world and through a cloud transition. Highlights: Video into a layered WebGL world, Scroll-driven art direction, Cloud transition. Built with Three.js · WebGL · JavaScript. Live demo at https://suhailchalil.github.io/rose-eternelle/.
